receipt.architecture: Actual native RuVector ranking and exact frozen epoch6 coherent source/context policy, with fixed FP32 pretrained 24-layer/1024 DeBERTa-v3-large threeway NLI reader. All3 retrieval arms share the exact old policy tokenizer/packer and new singleton reader. At most40 ranked anchors; same-paragraph neighbors may be inspected identically under512 tokens. Legacy top2 names are variable-unit compatibility aliases. Native104 reads the same primary excerpt, not submitted full-input104. Model performance is unmeasured until the controlled corpus run.
